WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
         COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id*1000+f.line_no) AS dist_rl
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, sold.units, sold.line_rows, sold.dist_lines, sold.dist_rl, COALESCE(ret.ret_units,0) ret_units
FROM sold JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=sold.sku AND cp.is_current LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.sku=sold.sku
ORDER BY sold.units DESC LIMIT 8

WITH units AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, u.sku, cp.product_name, u.units_sold
FROM units u
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = u.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY u.units_sold DESC, u.sku
LIMIT 3
